items.name: performance-report
items.title: Performance report
items.description: Display of a native analytics.Performance report: lookback tiles, the summary table, cumulative, drawdown, rolling, monthly and annual return figures and drawdown episodes.
items.docs: Display-only view of the report returned by usePerformanceReport (analytics.Performance over a host-supplied panel). A ticker control selects the per-ticker sections. Lookback tiles show MTD, QTD, YTD and FYTD to the returned reference date; the summary is the returned TableEnvelope; cumulative returns (every ticker), drawdown, rolling series, monthly returns (heatmap) and annual returns are drawn against each ticker's own active dates; drawdown episodes are listed largest first. Values are the decimal fractions and ratios Rust returns, with no units inferred; non-finite values are left out of figures and shown as returned elsewhere. The monthly colour domain is the caller's, else the extent of the returned values. Accepts report, loading, error, initialTicker, monthlyDomain, formatValue and density props; no worker or query provider required.

items.name: benchmark-report
items.title: Benchmark report
items.description: Display of a native analytics.Performance benchmark report: regression, beta and relative-measure tables, outperformance and drawdown-difference areas, rolling alpha and beta and an optional multi-factor table.
items.docs: Display-only view of the report returned by useBenchmarkReport (analytics.Performance against a named benchmark over a host-supplied panel). A fund control selects the ticker, defaulting to the first ticker that is not the benchmark. Key-value tables show the fund's greeks (alpha, beta, R squared, adjusted R squared, observations), its beta estimate with standard error and confidence bounds, and its tracking error, information ratio, Treynor, M squared, up and down capture, capture ratio and batting average. Cumulative outperformance and drawdown difference are drawn against the fund's exact paired benchmark dates, rolling alpha and beta against the returned window-end dates; the multi-factor regression (alpha, one beta per factor, R squared, adjusted R squared, residual volatility, observations) or its native error is shown when a factor panel was supplied. Values are the decimal fractions and ratios Rust returns, with no units inferred; non-finite values are left out of figures and shown as returned elsewhere. Accepts report, loading, error, initialTicker, formatValue and density props; no worker or query provider required.

items.name: correlation-heatmap
items.title: Correlation heatmap
items.description: Pearson correlation matrix of host-supplied return series as a heatmap and a table, with its common sample count and return-ending bounds.
items.docs: Presents one native analytics.Performance correlationMatrix result as returned: a diverging heatmap over the fixed correlation range [-1, 0, 1] and a table of every coefficient, rows and columns in Rust's ticker order, with the actual shared observation count and first/last return-ending dates supplied by Rust. Rust returns a unit diagonal and every coefficient inside [-1, 1]. Connect useCorrelationMatrix. Accepts report, loading, error, formatValue and density props; no worker or query provider required.

items.name: use-performance-report
items.title: usePerformanceReport
items.description: Builds a native analytics.Performance report of a host-supplied returns or price panel through the WASM worker.
items.docs: new analytics.Performance of the request's PerformancePanel (prices or returns), then summary, cumulativeReturns, getDrawdownSeries, drawdownDetails, rollingSharpe, rollingVolatility and getActiveDatesForTicker per ticker, periodicReturns monthly and annual, lookbackReturns (an omitted date left to Rust, which uses the last active date; with a core.FiscalConfig only when a fiscal-year start is supplied) and sample metadata. Benchmark, frequency, annual-effective cash, per-observation MAR, independent Omega threshold, confidence, rolling window and episode count are supplied explicitly; the lookback date defaults to the last active panel date. Every handle is freed. Keyed on the complete request and worker session; native errors are returned unchanged. Requires the shared Finstack/Query provider.

items.name: use-benchmark-report
items.title: useBenchmarkReport
items.description: Builds a native analytics.Performance benchmark report of a host-supplied returns or price panel through the WASM worker.
items.docs: new analytics.Performance of the request's PerformancePanel, whose benchmark_ticker names the benchmark, then greeks, beta, trackingError, informationRatio, treynor, mSquared, upCapture, downCapture, captureRatio and battingAverage, and per ticker getPairedDates, cumulativeReturnsOutperformance, drawdownDifference, rollingGreeks and, when a factor panel is supplied, multiFactorGreeks (a ticker's rejected regression is returned as its native error). The observation frequency, annual-effective cash and rolling window are explicit; factor regressions use the total-investment response with an explicit cash rate and caller-aligned already-excess factors. The handle is freed. Keyed on the complete request and worker session; native errors are returned unchanged. Requires the shared Finstack/Query provider.

items.name: use-correlation-matrix
items.title: useCorrelationMatrix
items.description: Pearson correlation matrix of a host-supplied return or price panel, with its common-sample provenance, through the WASM worker.
items.docs: useCorrelationMatrix builds new analytics.Performance from the host PerformancePanel (prices or returns), then getTickerNames and correlationMatrix, freeing the handle: one native chain keyed on the snapshotted panel and worker session; null means no request. Returns the matrix, ticker identities, common observation count and return-ending bounds supplied by Rust. A panel Rust rejects (a zero-variance series, an interior missing value, fewer than two observations shared by all tickers) is the hook error. Requires FinstackQueryProvider.
